import asyncio
import os

from cyhole.jupiter import JupiterSwapClient
from solders.pubkey import Pubkey

async def main():
    # Initialize connection and keypair
    rpc_endpoint = os.getenv("SOLANA_RPC_URL", "https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com")
    keypair_path = os.getenv("KEYPAIR_PATH", os.path.expanduser("~/.config/solana/id.json"))
    
    keypair = Keypair.from_secret_key(
        open(keypair_path).read().split("key_pair_bytes: ")[1].split("\n")[0]
    )
    
    client = CyholeClient(rpc_endpoint)
    jupiter = JupiterSwapClient(client)
    
    # Token addresses
    sol_mint = Pubkey.from_string("So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112")
    usdc_mint = Pubkey.from_string("EPjFWdd5Au17hunznDAGiTstim1V2PaTY9aPXxr2adQ")
    
    amount_in_lamports = int(1e9)  # 1 SOL
    
    # Get swap quote
    quote = await jupiter.get_quote(
        input_mint=sol_mint,
        output_mint=usdc_mint,
        amount=amount_in_lamports,
        slippage_bps=50
    )
    
    print(f"Quote received: {quote.out_amount} USDC for {amount_in_lamports} lamports SOL")
    
    # Execute swap
    swap_tx = await jupiter.execute_swap(
        keypair=keypair,
        quote=quote,
        user_public_key=keypair.pubkey()
    )
    
    print(f"Swap executed: {swap_tx}")

    asyncio.run(main())
